listing.agent_seed_create:
Generate App Store listing CSV (data/appstore_info.csv) from the product description I provide.

Field limits (Apple official):
- name: 2–30 characters
- subtitle: ≤30 characters
- keywords: ≤100 characters, comma-separated with no space after commas
- description: ≤4000 characters, plain text, no HTML
- supportUrl / marketingUrl / privacyPolicyUrl: URLs with a protocol

Do not write promotionalText, What’s New, copyright, or review notes. Write back with csv_set_fields / propose_fix; append a new row if the locale is missing. Do not upload, and do not apply_fix automatically.
listing.agent_seed_edit:
Refine listing copy for locale {locale}.
Limits: name 2–30, subtitle ≤30, keywords ≤100, description ≤4000.
Write back with csv_set_fields / propose_fix (append the locale if missing). Do not invent screenshot files or upload.

iap.agent_seed_create:
Generate iap_packages.json from the product table or description I provide.

groupLevel is the service rank inside a subscription group: smaller number = higher rank (1 is highest); the same level is a crossgrade. Never fill groupLevel silently — propose values and wait for confirmation.

Display name 2–30 characters, description ≤45.

Paste the product table, or describe the IAPs / subscriptions to create.

Existing locales: {locales}
Display name must be 2–30 characters; description ≤45.
